items.question: Are payouts put on hold?
items.answer: Payouts can be put on hold under certain conditions, such as fraud suspicion (If an affiliate’s traffic appears fraudulent, payouts may be paused pending further investigation) or quality verification. The hold may also be caused by any reasons for this that are specified within the framework of a particular deal.

items.question: How do I register with Makeberry?
items.answer: Visit the registration page, fill in your contact details and traffic sources, and our manager will get back to you within one business day to finalize the onboarding.

items.question: What is the minimum payout amount?
items.answer: The default minimum payout is $100, but it can be adjusted individually depending on your traffic volume and the offers you work with.

items.question: What countries does Makeberry work with?
items.answer: We run offers across Tier 1, Tier 2 and Tier 3 — including LATAM, Europe, Africa, MENA and Asia. The full live list and per-country payouts are available in your dashboard after registration.

items.question: What types of traffic are prohibited by Makeberry?
items.answer: We do not accept incentivized traffic, brand bidding, fraudulent installs/leads, malware/popunder, misleading creatives, and any traffic that violates the brand’s terms or local regulations.

items.question: On what grounds can traffic be considered fraudulent?
items.answer: Indicators include abnormal conversion-to-deposit ratio, suspicious geo / device patterns, repeat fingerprints, bot signatures, and any data inconsistencies flagged by our anti-fraud system or by the brand.

items.question: How much can affiliates earn with Makeberry?
items.answer: Earnings depend on the model (CPA, RevShare or Hybrid), GEO and traffic quality. Our top affiliates earn well into six figures per month — your dedicated manager will help build the optimal plan for your sources.
